notes: Arc Publishing site. Probes: GET /robots.txt 200, permissive (no relevant Disallow), names sitemap index https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap-index/?outputType=xml. Index (200, ~3341 entries) lists one urlset PER DAY /arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap<N>/YYYY-MM-DD/?outputType=xml going back to 2017-09-02, so the whole 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 window is present (no missing days). Final route: fetch index, fetch the 31 per-day sitemaps (all 200), parse <loc>. Listed date = the date in the article URL path /section/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/ (site-stated publication date), NOT <lastmod> (Arc record-update time, can differ after edits). Verified: path date == page JSON-LD datePublished exactly (e.g. /entretenimiento/2026/10/20/... datePublished 2026-10-20T23:41:44.081Z). Result: 2431 unique URLs, 31/31 days, min 17 (2026-10-25, newest Sunday; other Sundays/Saturdays 31-43 = the site's own weekend pace, counts read straight from the per-day sitemaps). Self-check: 2026-09-30=103, 2026-10-10=40, 2026-10-20=107 (all >=15); 4 random sample re-fetches all HTTP 200, page datePublished equal to listed date, 8100-8600 chars of body text. ~35 requests total, ran in ~20s.
